name: Haraka Self-Hosted SMTP Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed Node.js SMTP server and outbound delivery engine with extensible plugins; free to run on your own infrastructure without a software license fee or published usage quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted software only: provide server, DNS, IP reputation, storage/IMAP backend if needed, monitoring and outbound connectivity. Haraka is not an IMAP server or mailbox store. SMTP port restrictions, provider bandwidth and third-party plugin/service costs may apply.
